About

Nodes, links, stats and icons come from GGG's official export, atlastree-export 3.30.0. The export still lists 138 total points; the 3.30 patch notes say 150, so the counter uses 150.

Gateways: allocating a gateway lets you path on from its paired gateway, as in game. Multiple-choice notables let you pick one effect in the Selected panel.

Plans are saved in this browser. Use the plan code to share one.
